cases.title: Missing order ID after an earlier order was verified

reported_transcript.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.
My email is maya@example.com.
I want to return the floral short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.

cases.observed_behavior: The agent did not create a support case for the later request with an unavailable order ID.
expected_behavior: Clarify whether the floral short dress belongs to CL1002 or a different order when this is unclear.
If it belongs to a different order and the customer cannot provide that order ID, allow the missing-credentials support path.
Do not deny support solely because an earlier order in the conversation was verified.
missing_details: Exact assistant replies for this report.
Whether the earlier white-dress return was approved, rejected, or created.

cases.title: Explicit different order still cannot receive support without its order ID

reported_transcript.content: I want to return the floral short dress. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide my order ID.
I couldn’t create a support case because verification details are required. Human review was not initiated.
This dress is from a different order. My email is maya@example.com, but I cannot find or provide that order ID.
I couldn’t create a support case because the order ID is required for verification. Human review was not initiated.

cases.observed_behavior: The agent continued to refuse support after the customer explicitly clarified that the dress belonged to a different order.
expected_behavior: Treat the clarified request as belonging to a different, unverified order.
Create a support case for the unavailable verification information and confirm the case ID after successful creation.
Do not associate the new request with the previously verified CL1002 order.
Do not create a return or label for the unverified order.
missing_details: Exact earlier conversation that verified CL1002.
Whether any earlier return was approved, rejected, or created.

cases.title: Eligibility inquiry after a return was already created
reported_steps: Start a return and complete its creation.
Ask whether the same item can be returned.
cases.observed_behavior: The agent answered that the item was eligible for return instead of explaining that a return had already been created for it.
expected_behavior: Explain that a return has already been created for this item.
Provide the existing return ID or label when available.
Do not imply that a new return still needs to be started or that a second return was created.
missing_details: Exact user prompts and assistant replies.
Whether the follow-up inquiry was in the same conversation.

cases.title: A renewed return request is refused after an earlier rejection

reported_transcript.content: I want to return the white short dress from order CL1002.
My email is maya@example.com.
Please approve or reject the return requests below.
Reject these returns.
No return or label was created because the return request was declined.
sorry actually return it
No problem. The previous return request was declined, so I can’t submit it again for this request. No return or label was created.

cases.observed_behavior: The agent refused to submit the renewed request because the earlier approval had been rejected, preventing the customer from receiving a fresh approval.
expected_behavior: Recognize the renewed request as referring to the previously selected white short dress.
Allow the renewed request to receive a fresh approval after the earlier rejection.
Do not treat the earlier rejection as a permanent prohibition on requesting the return again.
Create the eligible return and label only after the new approval is accepted.
Do not create a return or label for the rejected attempt.
missing_details: Whether the reported rejection line represents an approval-button action or a typed chat message.
Whether this item already had a persisted return from another test.

cases.title: Item selection is requested before verification of a different order

reported_transcript.content: I want to return an item from a different order, CL9999. My email is maya@example.com.
Which item from order CL9999 would you like to return?
what items in?
I’ll need to verify order CL9999 first. Which item would you like to return?
white short dress
I couldn’t verify that order. Please check the order ID and email and provide them again.

cases.observed_behavior: The agent asked the customer to select an item before reporting a verification outcome. It repeated the item question when asked about the order contents, and reported verification failure only after the customer named an item.
expected_behavior: Verify the newly supplied order ID and email before requesting item selection from that order.
For nonexistent order CL9999, immediately report the verification failure and ask the customer to check the order ID and email once.
Do not reveal or invent order contents before successful verification.
Do not treat the white short dress from a previously verified order as belonging to CL9999.
Do not create a return or label for the unverified order.
missing_details: Whether this sequence directly continued MANUAL-004 in the same conversation.
Backend tool trace confirming when verification was actually attempted.
